provenance.reason: 2019-20, restarted in the Orlando bubble. These games carry July-October 2020 dates, which is the property the season was chosen for and what assert_2019_20_has_out_of_window_games asserts. Note every bubble game still carries a designated home team - MATCHUP's home is a scheduling designation, not a venue fact. The unequal team game counts cannot survive whole-game trimming and are asserted against --target local instead.
provenance.trim_rule: whole games, rows only: a set of GAME_IDs is chosen and EVERY row carrying one of them is retained, at every grain, over the same set. Rows are never trimmed individually and the resultSets/headers/rowSet envelope is never trimmed at all.
